newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa money mkt shortage eases Friday, Saturday.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa money mkt shortage eases Friday, Saturday.

text.p: South Africa's money market shortage eased at the weekend, totalling 8.800 billion rand on Friday and 8.745 billion on Saturday, the Reserve Bank said.
This marked a sharp improvement on mid-week levels. The shortage stood at 9.823 billion on Thursday and 9.677 billion on Wednesday.

However, dealers said the money market shortage remained high for mid-month and pressure on liquidity was likely to continue until around the end of January with Christmas spending exacerbating the situation.

The "big four" banks quoted their three-month NCD rates at between 16.95 offered and 17.20 bid, while the 90-day Bankers' Acceptance rate was in a 16.30 to 16.60 percent range compared with Friday's 16.30 to 16.75 percent.
